# Unnamed selectors and --all classify dotenv files and generate file names.
exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'
exec sesam init --user admin
mkdir postgres
mkdir postgres/backup
cp raw-fixture postgres/backup/password.txt
cp env-fixture production.env
cp custom-fixture .env.production
exec sesam add postgres/backup/password.txt production.env .env.production
rm postgres/backup/password.txt production.env .env.production

exec sesam run --secret postgres/backup/password.txt -- sh -c 'cat "$SESAM_POSTGRES_BACKUP_PASSWORD_TXT"'
cmp stdout raw-fixture

exec sesam run --secret production.env -- env
stdout '^AUTO_TOKEN=dotenv-value$'
! stdout '^SESAM_PRODUCTION_ENV='

exec sesam run --secret .env.production --env-pattern '\.vars$' --env-pattern '^\.env\.[a-z]{1,12}$' -- env
stdout '^CUSTOM_TOKEN=custom-value$'

env SESAM_RUN_ENV_PATTERN='^\.env\.[a-z]{1,12}$'
exec sesam run --secret .env.production -- env
stdout '^CUSTOM_TOKEN=custom-value$'
env SESAM_RUN_ENV_PATTERN=

# Explicit mappings force file delivery even for dotenv suffixes.
exec sesam run --secret CONFIG=production.env -- sh -c 'cat "$CONFIG"'
cmp stdout env-fixture

exec sesam run --all --env-pattern '^\.env\.' -- env
stdout '^AUTO_TOKEN=dotenv-value$'
stdout '^CUSTOM_TOKEN=custom-value$'
stdout '^SESAM_POSTGRES_BACKUP_PASSWORD_TXT=/dev/fd/[0-9]+$'
stdout '^SESAM_README_MD=/dev/fd/[0-9]+$'

exec sesam run --all --secret PASS=postgres/backup/password.txt --env-file production.env --env-pattern '^\.env\.' -- sh -c 'cat "$PASS"'
cmp stdout raw-fixture

# Names are derived after cwd-relative paths have been canonicalized.
cd postgres/backup
exec sesam run --secret ./password.txt -- sh -c 'cat "$SESAM_POSTGRES_BACKUP_PASSWORD_TXT"'
cmp stdout ../../raw-fixture
cd ../..

! exec sesam run --secret production.env --env-pattern '[' -- touch started-pattern
stderr 'invalid env pattern'
! exists started-pattern
! exists postgres/backup/password.txt
! exists production.env
! exists .env.production

-- raw-fixture --
raw-value
-- env-fixture --
AUTO_TOKEN=dotenv-value
-- custom-fixture --
CUSTOM_TOKEN=custom-value
